product_name: AWS Private Certificate Authority (AWS Private CA)
product_brief: AWS Private CA enables creating CAs and issuing certificates using ML-DSA for post-quantum cryptography transition.
pqc_capability_description: Supports Module Lattice-based Digital Signature Algorithm (ML-DSA), standardized by NIST as FIPS 204. Enables creating CAs, issuing certificates, creating CRLs, and configuring OCSP responders using ML-DSA. Available for testing in certificate issuance, identity verification, and code signing.
fips_validated: No (ML-DSA is standardized as FIPS 204, but product FIPS validation status is not stated)
primary_platforms: AWS (all commercial AWS Regions, AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, and China Regions)
pqc_roadmap_details: Enables transitioning PKI towards post-quantum cryptography to protect against future quantum computing threats.
signature_schemes: ML-DSA (current/planned), RSA (current, expected to be phased out), ECDSA (current, expected to be phased out)
